subject: Meridian renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation, log retention horizon & capacity plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@meridiandata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation, log retention horizon & capacity plan

Hi Elaine —

Happy Friday. Meridian's renewal is coming up next quarter and we wanted to align early on the SOC 2 re-attestation scope and a couple of potential commercial items: a modest seat uplift (approx +15%), and a change to the log retention horizon for audit logs.

High-level asks from our side so we can prepare a proposal and the evidence bundle: 
- Confirm whether Meridian will require SOC 2 re-attestation for the renewal (I believe yes per last renewal call).
- If yes, confirm desired retention horizon for audit logs (current contract: 365 days). Meridian mentioned 540–720 days as a possibility — can you confirm target?
- Any timing constraints for evidence upload (windows we should avoid for your auditors)?

Attached is a draft control matrix and an initial evidence-upload plan. If retention changes are required, we can propose a term amendment with pricing to cover storage and throughput for burst exports. Kimberly (cc'd) will mirror this into a commercial proposal once we lock scope.

Proposed next steps: quick 30-min sync next week to confirm retention target and evidence cadence. Are you available Mon/Tue morning PT?

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-control-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), evidence-upload-plan.csv (csv)
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@meridiandata.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security+procurement@meridiandata.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Meridian renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation, log retention horizon & capacity plan

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the heads-up and for the attachments. Yes, we will require SOC 2 re-attestation as part of the renewal; our internal audit lead wants the control mapping verified against their checklist. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Retention horizon: leaning toward 540 days for primary audit logs, with an option to archive to cold storage for 720 days total. Will you be able to support a hot+cold model?

2) Evidence upload windows: our auditors want evidence available in the 2027-11 to 2027-12 window. We have an internal freeze the week of Thanksgiving — please avoid scheduling large bulk uploads then.

3) Seats & throughput: the app usage has grown — we expect the +15% seat ask you mentioned. Also want to ensure burst throughput during our testing (simulated replay of logs) is covered.

Can Kimberly and your security team propose a timeline and call out costs for hot vs. hot+cold retention? Also attach any sample audit manifest you expect us to populate.

Best,
Elaine
Senior IT Audit Manager
Meridian Data
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@meridiandata.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 11:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation, log retention horizon & capacity plan

Hi Elaine —

Thanks — we can do that. Quick preview of what we'll propose: 
- 540-day hot retention as the baseline (includes searchable audit log access).
- Optional cold-tier archival to reach 720 days total; cold retrievals incur retrieval fees and 24–48h access SLA.
- Seat uplift pricing: I'll attach a short commercial appendix in the follow-up, with both monthly and annual commit options and a headroom burst allowance for the audit replay window.

Rishi, can you confirm technical feasibility for the hot+cold model and whether we can support a scheduled bulk export (S3-compatible) in the Nov 2027 window? Elaine noted a freeze around Thanksgiving — we'll avoid that week.

Elaine — would 30 minutes on Tue 21 Sep 10:00–10:30 PT work for a quick alignment?

Kimberly
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@meridiandata.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 07:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation, log retention horizon & capacity plan

Elaine / team —

Short answer: yes, we can support a 540-day hot retention with optional cold archival to 720 days. Details and constraints below.

Plan / technical notes: 
- Storage tiers: we propose using our hot retention (SSD-backed indexable logs) for 540 days. Cold archival will be to customer-controlled S3 (or Redwood-managed cold buckets) with immutability flags for the requested retention.
- Search & audit access: hot retains full search capabilities. Cold-serving requires a staged restore (24–48h), or we can provide a lightweight rollup index for quick lookups for a small monthly fee.
- Bulk evidence export: we will stage a bulk S3 export (ndjson gz) for the auditors. We can pace the export outside Meridian's freeze — suggested windows: 2027-11-01 to 2027-11-10, or the week after Thanksgiving (2027-11-29 to 2027-12-03). Let us know which you prefer.
- Throughput guarantees: for the replay window we can guarantee burst throughput up to 3x baseline for up to 72 consecutive hours if the seat uplift is committed in the renewal. Otherwise burst is best-effort and may be throttled.
- Evidence manifest: attached sample manifest that maps control IDs to file paths and retention tags. We will need Meridian to confirm control IDs and supply any missing ownership notes.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Soojin/Kimberly to confirm commercial terms (seat uplift + 540 hot / optional 720 cold).
2) Meridian to confirm preferred export window and whether Redwood should manage cold buckets or Meridian will provide their S3 credentials.
3) Kickoff: technical onboarding (1hr) by mid-Oct to validate manifest mappings and S3 connectivity.

Attachments included: retention-amendment-draft.docx (term language), evidence-upload-plan.csv (detailed schedule), SOC2-control-matrix.xlsx (control map).

Rishi
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@meridiandata.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 16:38:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Meridian renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation, log retention horizon & capacity plan

Kimberly / Soojin —

Thanks for the clear options and the draft term language. Meridian prefers: 
- Baseline: 540-day hot retention.
- Cold: Meridian will manage cold S3 buckets (we'll provide credentials and lifecycle policy) and pay retrieval fees if we need restores during the post-audit year.
- Export window: please target 2027-11-01 to 2027-11-10 (that avoids our mid/late-Nov freeze).
- Seats: we confirm the +15% uplift as a temporary committed increase for 12 months, with a review at the 9-month mark.

We accept the proposed burst throughput guarantee tied to the committed uplift. Please send the redline-ready term amendment and the commercial appendix so our procurement team can review. Also send the sample evidence manifest we will populate during technical onboarding.

Proposed calendar items: 
- Tech onboarding: 2027-10-18 11:00 PT (1hr) — Rishi will lead.
- Commercial review (procurement): deliver term amendment + appendix by 2027-09-24 EOD.

I'll loop in procurement once we have the amendment.

Best,
Elaine
Senior IT Audit Manager
Meridian Data
